prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished editorial 3D raster background for the Competencies tab of BinaHub's program-recommendation landing; not a UI mockup.
Primary request: A sculptural composition of three translucent optical-glass lenses, separate overlapping oblong prisms standing in a graceful connected arrangement, symbolizing distinct capabilities working together. Refined contemporary product-launch materiality, not a chart or interface. Pale mineral seafoam and soft ice-teal studio background, BinaHub deep navy #0B2C6B subtly refracted inside clear aqua glass, very restrained champagne rim highlights. Physically convincing soft daylight and fine ambient shadows, premium calm not flashy. Landscape 3:2, the three lenses on the right two-thirds and lower half; upper left is quiet, very light negative space for separate HTML heading. Distinct from a flowing ribbon: solid lens forms, no ribbon, no helix. Objects contained with generous space. No words, typography, symbols, logos, people, watermark, stars, gradients painted as fake UI, charts or controls. Do not bake blur into the whole image; the web page adds frosted glass as a separate layer.
usage: Decorative editorial artwork for the matching manual tab; not a result or customer photograph.
